rules.statement: Increased and decreased modifiers of the same applicable type are additive with each other.
More and less modifiers are multiplicative modifiers applied after additive increased and decreased modifiers in the relevant calculation stage.
Added damage contributes flat damage to the skill's damage before percentage modifiers are applied.
Gain as Extra Damage creates additional damage of a destination type from damage of a source type; it is not the same operation as conversion.
Damage conversion changes damage from one damage type to another and conversion interactions must be evaluated in their defined conversion order.
Resistance reduction changes the target's resistance, while penetration changes effective resistance only for the relevant Hit calculation and does not apply to Damage over Time.
Exposure is a resistance-reducing debuff applied to an enemy and is distinct from penetration.
A modifier applies only when its wording and the skill's properties match; for example, attack damage, spell damage, projectile damage, and damage with ailments are distinct scopes.
A critical strike deals extra damage based on Critical Strike Multiplier; the exact default and modifier interactions must be read from the current PoB calculation context.
